description: Source code for the LSM6DSO sensor driver, handling interrupt configuration, trigger setting, and interrupt handling for a 6-axis IMU sensor in Zephyr RTOS.

methods.name: lsm6dso_enable_t_int
methods.description: Enables or disables temperature interrupt pin.

methods.name: lsm6dso_enable_xl_int
methods.description: Enables or disables accelerometer data ready interrupt.

methods.name: lsm6dso_enable_g_int
methods.description: Enables or disables gyroscope data ready interrupt.

methods.name: lsm6dso_trigger_set
methods.description: Links external trigger to data ready event for accelerometer, gyroscope, or temperature.

methods.name: lsm6dso_handle_interrupt
methods.description: Handles the data ready interrupt, reads status, and calls registered handlers.

methods.name: lsm6dso_gpio_callback
methods.description: GPIO callback for interrupt pin, disables GPIO and signals processing thread.

methods.name: lsm6dso_thread
methods.description: Thread function for handling interrupts in own thread context.

methods.name: lsm6dso_work_cb
methods.description: Work callback for handling interrupts in global thread context.

methods.name: lsm6dso_init_interrupt
methods.description: Initializes GPIO interrupt for data ready signals, sets mode, and configures callback.
